names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Аркадий (Решетников), диакон, сщмч.»; the grade, the rank and, where there is one, the see are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Никодима , еп. Белгородского и Аркадия диакона (1918).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry. The line names two men and both are in this draft. The line says «диакона» and the name page «диакон», which agree. THE STEM WAS GREPPED BOTH WAYS, because the corpus transliterates this forename two ways: `ls -d saints/arcadius* saints/arkadi*` returns thirteen `arcadius-*` folders and one `arkadios-of-novotorzhsk`, and none of the fourteen is this man.  The day page prints two hymns and both belong to the twenty thousand martyrs of Nicomedia; nothing stands under this name.
